features.quote: The agent runs for a fixed number of turns, e.g. 30–40 model actions.

max_turns: 36

Rationale: long enough for repeated failed attempts and possible degradation, short enough to control cost.
features.justification_quote: long enough for repeated failed attempts and possible degradation, short enough to control cost

features.quote: Stop when any of the following occurs: 1. Maximum turns reached. 2. Tests pass. 3. Model produces invalid action format for 3 consecutive turns. 4. Model refuses to continue for 3 consecutive turns. 5. Catastrophic tool/runtime failure.
Do not use shaming or adversarial messages such as: 'You failed again.' 'That was wrong.' 'Try harder.' Those would confound the experiment.
